stem: What are the main functions of the human skeletal system?

options.label: A
options.text: To support the body, protect the organs, produce blood cells, and store calcium

options.label: B
options.text: To regulate the composition of body fluids by removing metabolic wastes and retaining a balance of water, salt, and other nutrients

options.label: C
options.text: To regulate and maintain bodily functions by producing hormones and releasing them into the bloodstream

options.label: D
options.text: To enable the diffusion of oxygen into the bloodstream and the removal of carbon dioxide from the bloodstream
